# [TASK] Implement Shared Library

## Task
Shared library module holding the data transfer objects, exceptions,
constants and utilities the backend services have in common.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Common data transfer objects exist and are tested: `ApiResponse`,
      `ErrorResponse`, `PageResponse`, `HalResource`
      (`ApiResponseTest`, `ErrorResponseTest`, `PageResponseTest`,
      `HalResourceTest`)
- [x] Six exception classes and the constant classes exist and are tested
      (`BusinessExceptionTest` and the other exception tests under
      `backend/shared-library/src/test/java/dev/lmdb/shared/exception/`)
- [x] The utility classes are implemented and unit-tested
      (`DateUtilsTest`, `StringUtilsTest`, `ValidationUtilsTest`)
- [x] Rescoped: the four custom annotations `@LogExecutionTime`,
      `@ValidateRequest`, `@RateLimited` and `@CacheResult` were deleted by
      #29 in `e44ce74`. They were bare declarations with no aspect behind
      them, unused, and redundant with Spring's `@Cacheable`, Bucket4j and
      `@Valid`. There is no annotation package in the module today
      (`find backend/shared-library/src/main/java -name '*.java'`)
- [x] The services import the library
      (`ProjectStructureTest.settingsGradleIncludesExactlyTheNineBackendModules`;
      six services declare it in their `build.gradle`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
Implemented 2025-11-16 in `c9442dc`, with Java Platform Module System support
in `0d81c65` and MapStruct/Lombok config in `fdefd50`.

The annotation criterion was ticked and false from #29 until this audit found
it on 2026-09-02.
